thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired PDINC12345 for service=inference-api — symptom: p99 latency > 1200ms over 5m window. Alerting: eng-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PDINC12345 :rotating_light:

sara: acked on PD. I'm on it.

mike: seeing p95 jump too in eu-west. Dashboards: https://grafana.example/dashboard/db/inference?orgId=1 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ada: onboard console, checking autoscaler and GPU pool. Quota looks borderline in eu-west.

sara: any recent deploys?

mike: no deploys. Logs show batcher backlog and repeated KV cache evictions. Quick grep: `grep -i "evict" /var/log/sidecar.log | tail -n 30` shows spikes at the same time.

sara: rolling quick mitigation: reducing aggregation batch size for sidecar. Command: `kubectl set env deployment/batcher BATCH_MAX=4 --namespace=prod-eu` applying now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: acknowledged by sara. Escalation timer set for 8m.

kevin: support heads-up: could be customer impact for high-throughput tenants. Prep a short advisory?

support-bot: Draft created: "We are investigating increased request latency in EU. We have applied mitigations and are monitoring. More updates soon."

mike: I can trigger a manual scale of dedicated capacity while we root-cause. Increasing replicas +2 for `inference-pool-eu`. Doing `replicas: current+2` now.

ada: manual scale done, but autoscaler didn't kick due to quota limit. Raised ticket with infra quota team. For now manual burst in place.

sara: after batch size change + scale: p95 dropped to ~210ms but p99 is ~1.1s. Still tail latency.

mike: correlating with hot keys. Top 1% of keys are 70% of traffic; KV cache thrashing under TTL churn. I'm collecting top keys: `select key, count(*) from requests where region='eu' group by key order by count desc limit 50`

sara: if p99 doesn't improve in 6m, plan B is to fail traffic for eu-west to the fallback model (lower memory, slightly lower quality) to protect latency SLOs. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

ada: go for it. I'll flip the routing canary once OK.

kevin: CS note ready to send to impacted accounts if we failover. No public status page update yet.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalated PDINC12345 to L2 (mike) per escalation policy.

mike: acknowledging escalation. Starting selective KV eviction for top 20 hotkeys and pinning small working set. Commands: `redis-cli --scan` + eviction script.

sara: performing warm failover now: switching route-policy to prefer `inference-model-small-v2` for 10% -> 50% -> 100% in 2m steps.

support-bot: Sending advisory to flagged customers (alpha/beta group) now. Template: "We are applying mitigations to address elevated latency in EU. Some requests may see a lower-quality model temporarily while we stabilize."

mike: p99 improved to ~420ms after eviction and partial failover, p95 ~200ms. Tail flattening visible but still watching for regressions.

sara: great. Hands-off mitigation checklist: reduced batch size, manual scale, KV eviction, partial model failover. Monitoring for 15m at least.

ada: noting infra action item: raise autoscaler threshold and add quota alert so manual burst isn't required next time.

kevin: I'll finalize customer communications and follow up with impacted accounts.

mike: leaving a snippet for postmortem: detected by pd alert -> root cause hotkey surge -> sidecar batcher backlog -> kv cache churn -> tail latency. Mitigations listed above.

sara: handing off to night oncall @kevin in 25m. Summary for handoff:
- root cause: hotkey traffic spike causing KV evictions and sidecar backlog
- mitigations applied: reduced batch size, manual scale (+2), selective eviction, partial model failover, customer advisory
- outstanding: autoscaler tuning, quota request, hotkey throttle rule, canary for auto-failover

kevin: acked handoff. Will watch the dashboards and send any updates.

incident-bot: PDINC12345 closed by sara. Please add postmortem and link to regressions/evals. :white_check_mark:

sara: filing postmortem and assigning owners: mike -> autoscaler/hotkey throttle; ada -> infra quota + autoscaler thresholds; kevin -> customer comms and runbook update. Will link to monitoring graphs and logs in the doc.
